items.title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas Recommends INDY, KAEF, and INDF Stocks for Thursday, October 8, 2026
items.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends three stocks for trading on Thursday, October 8, 2026: INDY, KAEF, and INDF. INDY rebounded 5.45% to 2,710 from support at 2,400-2,610 and trades above its MA20 of 2,724, with a breakout above resistance at 2,790 opening a path to 2,870; around 99% of Awak Mas Gold Project capex in semester I-2026 was allocated to non-coal businesses, with C2 construction 60.63% complete as of June 2026 and cumulative investment of US$340 million. KAEF rebounded to 446 from strong support at 390-408 and reclaimed the 435 area, with a bullish MACD crossover and potential to test 460-480; it is the only Indonesian pharmaceutical producer to receive an MPP-Roche sublicense to develop and produce generic baloxavir. INDF rebounded to 6,950 from support at 6,675-6,480 and approaches resistance at 7,000, with a breakout opening a move toward 7,170; its semester I-2026 revenue rose 9% YoY to Rp 65.53 trillion, operating profit rose 14% to Rp 13.29 trillion, and core profit rose 7% to Rp 6.18 trillion.

items.title: PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) Records Rp 26.1 Trillion Negotiation Market Transaction Ahead of Jhonlin Baratama Acquisition
items.body: PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) recorded three jumbo transactions worth Rp 26.1 trillion on the negotiation market on Wednesday (7/10/2026), involving around 10.08 billion shares at Rp 2,588 per share, nearly matching the 10.08 billion shares (about 30% of BYAN) that PT Jhonlin Baratama will acquire under an amended conditional share purchase agreement signed on 1 October 2026 by Low Tuck Kwong, Elaine Low, and Jhonlin Baratama. The negotiation price was 76.53% below BYAN's regular market close of Rp 12,550 per share, and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas noted it reflects an annualized price-to-earnings ratio of about 6.1 times versus around 29.7 times on the regular market. Analysts at Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia said the transfer of about 30% of shares does not change control of the company, with no indication of a mandatory tender offer or board changes. The jumbo transaction occurred a day after Low Tuck Kwong sold 33.33 million shares at Rp 11,025 per share on 6 October 2026, reducing his stake to about 40.15%, while BYAN shares weakened 6.69% to Rp 12,550 in the regular market. Separately, Jhonlin Group affiliates PT Eshan Agro Sentosa, controller of PT Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR), and controlling shareholders of PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk (PGUN) pledged shares to PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) on 30 September 2026 as credit facility collateral, without changing control or causing dilution.

items.title: PT Gudang Garam Tbk (GGRM) Faces Sudden Foreign Selling Pressure Despite Strong H1-2026 Profit Recovery
items.body: PT Gudang Garam Tbk (GGRM) experienced renewed foreign net selling of Rp 4.01 billion between October 5-7, 2026, after recording net foreign buying from September 18 to September 30, and the stock closed down 1.02% at Rp 16,925 on October 7, 2026. The cigarette issuer's shares have fallen 15.69% over the past month after nearly reaching Rp 22,000 in August 2026. Despite the selling pressure, GGRM posted a significant profitability recovery in the first half of 2026, with gross profit up 58% to Rp 5.99 trillion, operating profit up 659.6% to Rp 3.9 trillion, and net profit surging 2,440% to Rp 2.98 trillion, though quarterly net profit fell 6.5% in the second quarter from Rp 1.54 trillion in the prior quarter. Sales volume declined 13.6% to 20.5 billion sticks, led by the SKM HT segment at 17.4 billion sticks (85.2% of production), with SKT & SKL at 3 billion sticks and SKM LT at 0.09 billion sticks. Phintraco Sekuritas maintained a buy recommendation with a target price of Rp 22,000, citing risks from illegal cigarette sales, weakening consumer purchasing power, and cigarette tax uncertainty.

items.title: PT Jinsheng Mining Increases Stake in PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT) by 110 Million Shares
items.body: PT Jinsheng Mining increased its shareholding in nickel mining issuer PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT) on October 5, 2026, purchasing 110 million shares at Rp700 per share for a total transaction value of Rp77 billion. Following the purchase, Jinsheng Mining's ownership rose to 3,706,671,278 shares, equivalent to 65.74%, up from 3,596,671,278 shares, or 63.79%. DKFT management stated the share purchase was for investment purposes. Despite the acquisition, DKFT's share price had declined 13.55% to Rp670 per share since the start of 2026, including a 6.29% drop in the past month, though it rose 0.75% in the second trading session on Wednesday (October 7) as of 15:13 WIB.

items.title: PT Mandiri Herindo Adoperkasa Tbk (MAHA) Posts 1,386% Net Profit Surge on Hauling Contract Backlog
items.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas (BRIDS) reviewed the first-half 2026 performance of PT Mandiri Herindo Adoperkasa Tbk (MAHA), one of Indonesia's largest coal transportation service providers. Revenue rose 34.1% year-on-year to Rp 1.65 trillion, with net profit surging 1,386% to Rp 139.5 billion from Rp 9.4 billion, boosted by a base effect after unrealized share investment losses of Rp 55.1 billion in 1H25; excluding this, pre-tax profit grew 108%. A hauling contract backlog from Bayan Group (Tabang Project) worth Rp 23.9 trillion through 2034 for 368 million tons provides long-term revenue visibility, with clients including Pamapersada (UNTR), Kideco (INDY), Multi Tambangjaya Utama (CUAN), and DEWA, besides MCOL affiliates. President Director Yenny Hamidah Koean bought an additional 11.25 million shares worth Rp 2 billion, raising her stake to 9.06%. MAHA trades at a PE of 6.2x and PBV of 1.27x with 20% RoE and a 0.02x DER; the stock closed at Rp 140 on October 7, 2026, down 18.60% year-to-date.

items.title: PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ) Draws Foreign Net Buying Amid Planned Rights Issue and Frisian Flag Acquisition
items.body: PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ), the producer of Ultra Milk, recorded foreign net buying of Rp 95.85 billion from September 30 to October 7, 2026, with the stock up 38% over the past month and closing flat at Rp 2,070 on October 7. ULTJ has announced a rights issue (PMHMETD IV) plan, with proceeds to be used in part to acquire all shares of PT Frisian Flag Indonesia (FFI) via an inbreng mechanism, in which FFI shareholders deposit 100% of FFI shares into ULTJ as non-cash capital. Following the transaction, FrieslandCampina International Holding BV (FCIH), the Dutch parent of Frisian Flag Indonesia, will become the new controlling shareholder of ULTJ and will conduct a mandatory tender offer for the remaining public shares under POJK No. 9/2018. ULTJ's current ultimate beneficial owner is Sabana Prawirawidjaja.

items.title: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk (GEMS) Sets Cum Date for US$200 Million Interim Dividend of Rp 611.93 per Share
items.body: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk (GEMS), a coal issuer under the Sinar Mas Group, will distribute an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 of US$200 million, or US$0,034 (Rp 611.93) per share, using the BI middle rate of US$1 = Rp 17,996 as of 30 September 2026. The cum date in the regular and negotiation markets falls on Thursday, 8 October 2026, with shareholders recorded on 12 October 2026 and payment scheduled for 22 October 2026. At the 7 October 2026 close of Rp 8,675, up 1.46%, the implied dividend yield is around 7.05%, and the stock has surged 19.66% over the past week. The dividend follows first-half 2026 net profit of US$219.96 million, up from US$151.67 million in the same period of 2025.

items.title: Adhi Karya (ADHI) to Repurpose Rp2.65 Trillion Right Issue Funds to Accelerate BUMN Streamlining Program
items.body: Adhi Karya (ADHI) plans to change the use of Rp2.65 trillion in funds, sourced from Rp1.97 trillion in 2022 state capital participation and Rp675.49 billion in right issue proceeds, to support the acceleration of the BUMN streamlining program and focus on its core business. The funds, previously allocated for capital injections into investment entities, will be redirected to working capital to accelerate project completion and cash in, serving as a liquidity buffer between cash out and cash in. Under the original allocation plan, Rp1.68 trillion was designated for capital injection into Jasamarga Jogja Solo for the Solo-Yogyakarta-YIA Kulonprogo toll project, Rp532.18 billion for PT Jasamarga Jogja Bawen for the Yogyakarta-Bawen toll project, Rp54.32 billion for Jalintim Adhi Abipraya, Rp2.69 billion for investment in waste processing and toll roads, and Rp378.69 billion for working capital to complete carry-over projects. The company stated the change is expected to improve business performance and shareholder value without negatively affecting its financial condition. The plan will be submitted for shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on Friday, 13 November 2026 at ADHI Tower in East Jakarta.

items.title: PT Mitra Pedagang Indonesia Tbk (MPIX) Director and Controlling Shareholder Sell Shares Below Market Price as Stock Soars 83%
items.body: PT Mitra Pedagang Indonesia Tbk (MPIX) director Rio Adetya Rizky and controlling shareholder PT Madura Prima Investama sold MPIX shares at Rp75 per share on October 5, 2026, well below the market price. Rio Adetya sold 20 million shares worth about Rp1.5 billion, cutting his voting stake from 1,5999% to 0.32%, leaving him with around 5 million shares. PT Madura Prima Investama sold 27.5 million shares worth Rp20.65 billion, reducing its holding to 910 million shares with a 58,2372% voting stake. Despite the sales, MPIX shares closed at Rp220 on October 7, 2026, up 1.85% on the day and 83.33% over the past month. No explanation was given for who bought the shares.

items.title: Popular News Roundup: Haji Isam Expands BYAN Stake, AMMN Explores Hong Kong Listing
items.body: This roundup of five popular investor.id stories as of Wednesday (7/10/2026) is anchored by Haji Isam's expanding control of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN). Low Tuck Kwong, Elaine Low, and PT Jhonlin Baratama signed an amended conditional share purchase agreement on 1 October 2026, increasing Jhonlin Baratama's purchase from 10,000,000,500 to 10,084,088,370 BYAN shares, giving Haji Isam an indirect 30.25% stake versus the 30% originally agreed on 16 September 2026. Citi hosted an investor meeting with PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) management, who cited stronger net profit prospects from rising ore grades in Batu Hijau Phase 8, increased processing capacity, and exploration of a dual listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Related stories cover Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR) and Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk (PGUN) pledging shares to PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) as credit collateral, Robert Budi Hartono buying 1,797,300 AVIA shares at Rp 330 (Rp 593.1 million total), and PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk (HRTA) signing an EMASKU product purchase agreement with Bank Mandiri.

items.title: First KDMP Loan Installment Payments to Himbara Banks Stall, Rp37 Trillion Still Held in Escrow
items.body: The government has prepared Rp37 trillion to pay the first KDMP (Koperasi Desa Merah Putih) loan installments due to Himbara banks on 25 September 2026, but disbursement from the escrow account at the Himbara banks remains pending verification and validation of the cooperatives, according to Deputy Finance Minister Juda Agung. UOB Kay Hian research dated 21 September 2026 said verification was behind schedule, with BNI reporting only three of roughly 24,000 KDMP buildings verified and none officially handed over, potentially shifting the first installment payment to October 2026 and risking reclassification of bank loan exposures to collectability level 2 with higher provisioning needs. Agrinas Pangan Nusantara President Director Joao Angelo De Sousa Mota cited Simkopdes data showing 36,289 cooperatives verified and 27,734 cooperatives 100% built. BNI, Bank Mandiri, and Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) had not responded to inquiries about the disbursement progress.

items.title: Madura Prima Investama Sells Shares of Mitra Pedagang Indonesia
items.body: Madura Prima Investama, an insider, sold 27,500,000 shares of Mitra Pedagang Indonesia at IDR 75 per share on Oct 5, 2026, generating proceeds of IDR 2,062,500,000. The sale reduced its holding from 937,500,000 to 910,000,000 shares, lowering ownership from 59.997% to 58.237%. The divestment follows recent insider disposals, including a 20,000,000‑share sale by Rio Adetya Rizky on Oct 7 and a combined 30,000,000‑share sale by Sahrul Akbariyansyah and Hendra Setiawan on Sep 25, reflecting a broader reduction of insider stakes.

items.title: Production Growth and Expansion Support PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO) Outlook Through 2029, Analyst Says
items.body: Analyst Kevin Yudha Pratama of Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia said PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO) retains positive growth prospects through 2029, supported by rising production and new geothermal projects. Production reached 3,222 GWh by July against a 5,255 GWh annual target, with an availability factor of around 99.5%, while first-half 2026 revenue grew 14.7% year-on-year to US$235.03 million and net profit rose 15.48% to US$79.61 million. Installed capacity is projected to increase from 727 MW in 2026 to about 1,027 MW in 2029, driven mainly by Hululais, co-generation and low pressure projects, and Gunung Tiga targeted for 2029, while Lumut Balai Units 3 and 4 are slated for 2030 and 2032. The analyst set a short-term share price target of Rp 1,000-Rp 1,040, citing a rebound to the MA50 area, with risks including project delays, reservoir conditions, rising development costs, and dependence on PLN.

items.title: PT Jinsheng Mining Strengthens Controlling Stake in PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT) with Rp77 Billion Share Purchase
items.body: PT Jinsheng Mining has increased its shareholding in PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT), spending Rp77 billion to buy 110 million shares at Rp700.00 per share on 5 October 2026 for investment purposes. The purchase raised Jinsheng Mining's holdings from 3,596,671,278 shares (63.79% of voting rights) to 3,706,671,278 shares (65.74% of voting rights), as reported on Monday (7/10/2026). With this corporate action, PT Jinsheng Mining reaffirmed its position as the controlling shareholder and its commitment to maintaining control over Central Omega Resources.

items.title: PT Plaza Indonesia Realty Tbk (PLIN) to Distribute Interim Dividend of Rp268.7 Billion
items.body: PT Plaza Indonesia Realty Tbk (PLIN), the issuer that manages the Plaza Indonesia luxury commercial complex and the Grand Hyatt Hotel, will distribute an interim dividend totaling Rp268.7 billion, approved by its Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners on October 5, 2026. Shareholders registered in the recording date list will receive Rp76 per share. The company stated the dividend will have no material impact on its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity. Key dates include cum dividend on October 15 and ex dividend on October 16, 2026 for the regular and negotiation markets, cum dividend on October 19 and ex dividend on October 20, 2026 for the cash market, recording date on October 19, and payment on October 27, 2026.

items.title: PT Fortune Indonesia Tbk (FORU) Records Rp 169.38 Billion in HMETD Executed, Rp 45.72 Billion Unexecuted in Jumbo Rights Issue
items.body: PT Fortune Indonesia Tbk (FORU) entered the new share recording stage of its Limited Public Offering (PUT) I rights issue on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX), with 169.38 billion pre-emptive rights (HMETD) executed between September 25 and October 6, 2026, while about 45.72 billion HMETD went unexecuted. FORU offered up to 215,096 billion new shares at Rp 126 per share, potentially raising around Rp 27.1 trillion including inbreng deposits. Controlling shareholder IMR Asia Holding Pte. Ltd. (IMR AH), which previously held about 76.81% of FORU, will exercise around 165,216 billion HMETD, partly via inbreng by depositing 49% of PT Borneo Prima, valued at about Rp 20.82 trillion. Non-participating shareholders face dilution of up to 99.78%, and FORU shares closed up 16.13% at Rp 144 on October 7, 2026, after falling 24.61% over five days.

items.title: Interim Dividend Yields vs Retail Government Bonds: Which Is More Attractive?
items.body: The article compares interim dividend yields offered by several Indonesian issuers against the government's retail Savings Bond (SBR015), which carries coupons of 6.75% for a two-year tenor and 6.85% for a four-year tenor with a floating-with-floor scheme. PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk (GEMS) plans an interim dividend of Rp 611.93 per share, an estimated yield of 7.05% based on its Rp 8,675 closing price on October 7, followed by PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk (TLDN) with Rp 20 per share (3.33% yield at Rp 600) and PT Plaza Indonesia Realty Tbk (PLIN) with Rp 76 per share (3.03% yield at Rp 2,510). Analysts note that yield comparison alone is insufficient, as retail SBN coupons and principal are government-guaranteed while stocks carry price volatility, and dividend sustainability depends on cash flow, payout ratios, balance sheet condition, and earnings performance. Rising bond yields, including high US Treasury yields, may keep retail SBN investors from shifting into high-dividend stocks, though improving risk-reward after the market correction since the September peak allows gradual accumulation of fundamentally attractive stocks.

items.title: PT Indointernet Tbk (EDGE) and Subsidiary Secure Rp1.7 Trillion Credit Facility from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA)
items.body: PT Indointernet Tbk (EDGE), together with its subsidiary PT Ekagrata Data Gemilang (EDG), obtained an additional credit facility of up to Rp1.7 trillion from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA). The nine-year facility carries a floating interest rate and will fund general business needs, including capital expenditure, fiber optic cable expansion, and data center and digital infrastructure development. Both companies will pledge assets as collateral, with guarantees exceeding 50% of each company's net assets, and will provide cross collateral for each other's obligations; the transaction is material as it exceeds 50% of Indointernet's equity, which stood at Rp1.81 trillion as of June 30, 2026. The companies stated the funding will strengthen their financing structure, improve flexibility and liquidity, and support short- and long-term cash flow amid growing customer demand for data center services.

items.title: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) to Invest US$200 Million in HighPeak Energy Inc via Convertible Preferred Shares
items.body: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) signed an agreement to invest US$200 million, equivalent to Rp 3.6 trillion, in newly issued convertible preferred shares of HighPeak Energy Inc, a US oil and gas company listed on Nasdaq under the ticker HPK. HighPeak focuses on hydrocarbon development and exploration in the Midland Basin, West Texas, with average sales volume of about 45,456 barrels of oil equivalent per day for the six months ended June 30, 2026. ENRG management said the investment is part of its inorganic growth strategy, will be funded independently without affecting reinvestment opportunities, and is expected to deliver synergy through technical knowledge transfer from the North American upstream industry. Kiwoom Sekuritas research viewed the transaction as strategically positive for ENRG, citing recurring income, potential capital gains, and strategic access to US oil and gas assets. On October 7, 2026, ENRG shares closed down 1.85%, or 20 points, at Rp 1,060, and have weakened 33.75% year to date.

items.title: Assessing Indonesian Stock Market Prospects and Foreign Fund Flows After FTSE Russell's Decision
items.body: FTSE Russell decided to keep Indonesia in the Secondary Emerging market category and not place it on its watchlist, citing reforms on shareholder transparency, investor classification, minimum free float requirements, and market surveillance. Despite the positive sentiment, the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 0.75% to 6,146 on Wednesday (7/10/2026), with foreign outflows of Rp 828.65 billion that day and Rp 109.45 trillion year to date. Analysts from PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia, Avere Investama, and PT Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia said the decision reduces downside risk but is not enough to stop outflows, with rupiah weakness near Rp 18,000 per US dollar and US Treasury yields around 5.2%-5.3% still weighing. Attention now turns to MSCI's November 2026 evaluation, with IHSG projections of 6,500-6,700 near-term (potentially 7,000 by end-2026) from Avere Investama and 6,400-6,600 from Samuel Sekuritas, while the Rp 1 tick-size policy was seen positively for stocks like PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO).

items.title: Danantara's US Oil and Gas Investment in High Peak Energy Seen Opening Strategic Opportunities
items.body: Danantara Investment Management (DIM) announced a US$250 million investment in US oil and gas company High Peak Energy Inc, executed through convertible preferred shares issued in stages. An analyst at Sinarmas Sekuritas said the move gives Danantara, as a sovereign wealth fund, access to strategic energy assets and opportunities for skills transfer through training and work assignments. High Peak Energy is a Texas-based company listed on Nasdaq with a market capitalization of about US$1 billion, operating in the Permian Basin, which accounted for 48% of US crude oil production in 2025. At the same time, PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) announced a US$200 million (around Rp3.6 trillion) investment in the same company via a similar convertible preferred share scheme, which the analyst linked to geographic expansion and technology mastery.

items.title: PT Multi Bintang Indonesia Tbk (MLBI) Shares Surge 20.70% Year to Date in 2026, Analysts Recommend Gradual Accumulation
items.body: Shares of PT Multi Bintang Indonesia Tbk (MLBI) rose 20.70% year to date to Rp 6,850 per share as of Wednesday (7/10/2026), outperforming peers in the consumer goods sector. The rally was supported by improving fundamentals, with first-half 2026 revenue growing about 16.9% and net profit up about 24.3%, alongside a Q1-2026 operating margin of 37.9%, a 100% dividend payout of net profit for fiscal years 2024 and 2025, and a valuation of around 11x PER based on TTM EPS of about Rp 611. Analysts from Mirae Asset Sekuritas, Infovesta Kapital Advisory, and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas view the stock as attractive for gradual accumulation on corrections, with a target price range of Rp 7,800-Rp 8,200, citing strong brands, pricing power, defensive characteristics, and Q4-2026 seasonal demand from the holiday season, tourism, and the horeca sector. Key risks include rising production costs, commodity price volatility, rupiah weakness, potential excise increases on alcoholic beverages, and valuation rerating after the price rally.

items.title: CPO Issuers Seen as Sector Winners: Analyst Stock Picks Highlight DSNG, TAPG, AALI, LSIP, JARR, and SSMS
items.body: Analysts view rising crude palm oil (CPO) prices and strong export levy receipts as positive catalysts for Indonesian plantation issuers, with CPO contributing significantly to export duty revenue that reached Rp 240.28 trillion by end-September 2026, or 71.51% of the 2026 state budget target. PT Indo Premier Sekuritas analyst Imam Gunadi estimates CPO issuers' core net profit could grow about 15% semester-on-semester in H2 2026 if CPO prices hold at the Q3 2026 average of MYR 4,548 per ton, with PT Astra Agro Lestari Tbk (AALI) the most sensitive at roughly 2% net income gain per MYR 100/ton increase, versus 0-1% for PT Dharma Satya Nusantara Tbk (DSNG), PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (TAPG), and PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk (LSIP). Imam picks DSNG as the top pick with a target price of Rp 2,000 per share, citing its relatively lagging performance and largest upside versus peers, while Mirae Asset Sekuritas' Nafan Aji Gusta recommends accumulating JARR and TAPG at targets of Rp 6,025 and Rp 2,280 per share, plus add ratings for LSIP and DSNG at Rp 1,875 and Rp 1,795 per share. Kiwoom Sekuritas' Azis recommends a trading buy on SSMS with a target of Rp 1,150 per share, and analysts see the B50 biodiesel mandate, effective July 1, 2026, as a price-supporting catalyst despite reducing export volumes.

items.title: Analysts Recommend Big Bank Stocks as Valuations Fall Well Below Historical Levels
items.body: Analysts view Indonesia's big banks as attractive after sharp 2026 price corrections pushed valuations well below historical averages, reflecting earnings-growth compression and higher risk premiums rather than structural fundamental deterioration. PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) trades at a price to earnings ratio (PER) of about 6.20x and price to book value (PBV) of 0.78x, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) at PER 6.15x and PBV 1.34x, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) at PER 7.77x and PBV 1.48x, while PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) retains a premium valuation at PER 12.85x and PBV 2.76x. Mirae Asset Sekuritas senior market analyst Nafan Aji Gusta recommends buy on all four, with target prices of Rp 4,020 for BBNI, Rp 4,720 for BMRI, Rp 3,570 for BBRI, and Rp 7,900 for BBCA, while Solstice Indonesia's Handiman Soetoyo picks BMRI as the most attractive risk-reward, citing 22.3% year-on-year bank-only profit growth in the first eight months of 2026, 23% PPOP growth, cost of credit at 0.6%, sustainable ROE of 18%, and a fair PBV range of 1.4-1.6x implying Rp 5,300-Rp 6,100 per share. Both analysts note cheap valuations alone are insufficient catalysts, requiring rupiah stabilization, lower cost of funds, NIM improvement, and solid credit growth to restore earnings expectations.

items.title: Brokers Behind BYAN's Rp 26.1 Trillion Negotiation-Market Trade on Wednesday (7/10) Revealed
items.body: A jumbo transaction of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) shares worth Rp 26.1 trillion took place on the Indonesia Stock Exchange negotiation market on Wednesday (7/10/2026), with PT Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia acting as the seller's broker and PT Mandiri Sekuritas as the buyer's broker. The trade occurred in three transactions at Rp 2,588 per share, totaling about 10.08 billion BYAN shares, close to the revised 10.08 billion shares BYAN disclosed would be transferred to PT Jhonlin Baratama. Separately, on 6 October 2026, Low Tuck Kwong sold 33.33 million BYAN shares at Rp 11,025 per share, worth Rp 367.50 billion, through PT UBS Sekuritas Indonesia as seller's broker with PT Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia as buyer's broker, reducing his stake to 13.38 billion shares, or 40.15%, from 40.25% previously.

items.title: PT Jinsheng Mining Buys 1.95% Stake in PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT) for Rp77 Billion
items.body: PT Jinsheng Mining, the controlling shareholder of nickel mining issuer PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT), purchased 110,000,000 shares, equivalent to 1.95% of the paid-up capital, on October 5, 2026 at Rp700 per share, for a total transaction value of Rp77 billion. The direct share purchase was stated to be for investment purposes. Following the transaction, PT Jinsheng Mining's holdings increased from 3,596,671,278 shares (63.79% of voting rights) to 3,706,671,278 shares (65.74% of voting rights). In trading, DKFT shares weakened 1.50%, or 10 points, to Rp655 as of the close at 4:00 PM WIB on Wednesday, October 7, 2026.

items.title: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk (AMRT) Stock Falls 36% as Analyst Cites Valuation Pressure and Outlines Outlook Through End-2026
items.body: Shares of PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk (AMRT) have declined about 36% since the start of 2026, with Korea Investment & Sekuritas Indonesia (KISI) Head of Research Muhammad Wafi attributing the drop mainly to valuation compression and foreign fund pressure rather than fundamental deterioration. Amid the correction, AMRT has prepared an interim dividend of Rp595.83 billion, or Rp14.5 per share, which Wafi views as a positive signal of cash generation, though the yield remains small compared with government bonds (SBN) around 7%. Performance through the end of 2026 is expected to remain resilient, supported by the seasonally strong fourth quarter and around Rp31 trillion in stimulus through food assistance and wage subsidy (BSU) programs that could flow into everyday spending. Key indicators to watch include same-store sales growth, gross margin, and the impact of rupiah weakness on imported goods prices, while Wafi's target price for AMRT remains under review.

items.title: PT Wulandari Bangun Laksana Tbk (BSBK) to Distribute Rp 25.09 Billion Interim Dividend
items.body: PT Wulandari Bangun Laksana Tbk (BSBK) will distribute an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 totaling Rp 25,091,882,375, equivalent to Rp 1 per share. The ex-dividend date on the regular and negotiation markets is October 14, 2026, and on the cash market is October 16, 2026, with the recording date on October 15, 2026, and payment scheduled for October 20, 2026. The dividend is supported by the company's net profit of Rp 39.83 billion for the period ended June 30, 2026, up from Rp 34.38 billion a year earlier. Revenue also grew from Rp 180.72 billion in June 2025 to Rp 182.55 billion at the end of June 2026.

items.title: Controlling Shareholders of Haji Isam's PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk (PGUN) and PT Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR) Pledge Shares to PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI)
items.body: Controlling shareholders of Haji Isam's issuers PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk (PGUN) and PT Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR) have pledged their shares to PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) as collateral for credit facilities obtained by the companies' affiliates, effective September 30, 2026. PT Eshan Agro Sentosa, holder of 86.64% of JARR shares, pledged 100% of its stake, while PGUN's three controlling shareholders—PT Araya Agro Lestari (38.44%), PT Citra Agro Raya (38.25%), and PT Baramega Cipta Mulia Persada (15.69%)—each pledged 100% of their holdings. Both companies stated the pledges do not change control, dilute ownership, or alter placed and paid-up capital. Separately, Haji Isam is acquiring PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) shares via PT Jhonlin Baratama, with a jumbo crossing transaction of 10.08 billion BYAN shares at Rp2,588 per share, worth Rp26.10 trillion and reflecting an approximately 79.9% discount to the regular market price of Rp12,875 per share.

items.title: PT Plaza Indonesia Realty Tbk (PLIN) to Distribute Rp 268.71 Billion Interim Dividend from Fiscal Year 2026
items.body: PT Plaza Indonesia Realty Tbk (PLIN) will distribute an interim dividend totaling Rp 268.71 billion from fiscal year 2026, amounting to Rp 76 per share, as disclosed to the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX). The cum dividend date in the regular and negotiation markets is October 15, 2026, with the ex dividend date on October 16, 2026; in the cash market, cum dividend falls on October 19, 2026 and ex dividend on October 20, 2026. The recording date is October 19, 2026, with payment scheduled for October 27, 2026. As of June 30, 2026, PLIN's profit for the period stood at Rp 266.84 billion, slightly up from Rp 265.53 billion a year earlier, while revenue rose from Rp 691.43 billion to Rp 723.33 billion.

items.title: Plaza Indonesia (PLIN) Announces Interim Dividend of Rp268.71 Billion, Check the Schedule
items.body: Plaza Indonesia Realty (PLIN) has announced an interim dividend totaling Rp268.71 billion. The article invites readers to check the dividend payment schedule. Further details on record and payment dates were not available in the article content.

items.title: Danantara Targets Nindya Karya-Brantas Abipraya and Adhi Karya-PP Mergers to Complete by November 2026
items.body: Danantara Indonesia Chief Operating Officer Dony Oskaria said the mergers of four state-owned construction companies are targeted to be completed by the end of November 2026. The mergers pair PT Nindya Karya with PT Brantas Abipraya (Persero), and PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk with PT PP (Persero) Tbk, with the surviving entity in each merger still under review based on financial, organizational, and human resource considerations. After the mergers, non-core assets will be divested to reduce debt, remaining debt will be restructured according to each company's repayment capacity, and financing will shift from corporate financing to a project-based model. PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk and PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk are not yet part of this wave because they remain in restructuring due to more complex financial problems, which Danantara intends to resolve fundamentally rather than merely extending debt tenors.

items.title: PT Apexindo Pratama Duta Tbk (APEX) to Issue 218.09 Million Shares via Private Placement
items.body: PT Apexindo Pratama Duta Tbk (APEX) will implement a private placement (PMTHMETD) by issuing 218.09 million Series B shares with a nominal value of Rp 325 per share, approved at an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders on 7 October 2026. The share issuance will be settled by compensating third-party receivables against APEX, with the new shares recorded on 20 October 2026 in the names of HSBC Bank PLC and The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited. HSBC Bank PLC will hold 62.31 million Series B shares, while The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited will hold 155.78 million Series B shares from the corporate action. Shareholders also approved amending Article 4 of the articles of association to reclassify shares into Series A with a nominal value of Rp 500 and Series B with a nominal value of Rp 325 per share.

items.title: PT Bank of India Indonesia Tbk (BSWD) Responds to IDX Trading Suspension, Expects Resumption Soon
items.body: PT Bank of India Indonesia Tbk (BSWD) addressed the temporary trading suspension imposed by the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) during a virtual public expose on Thursday (8/10/2026). Operations Director Carolina Dina Rusdiana said the company communicates with IDX almost daily to fulfill the requirements needed for the suspension to be lifted, and expects to complete all conditions on the same day. IDX suspended BSWD trading in the Regular and Cash Markets starting from the pre-opening session on Monday (5/10), citing a significant cumulative price increase as investor protection. Before the suspension, BSWD shares stood at Rp 3,600 per share, having risen 25% in a week, 140% in a month, and 165% over three months.

items.title: Danantara Indonesia Expects Merger of PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) and PT PP (Persero) Tbk (PTPP) to Be Completed by End of November
items.body: Danantara Indonesia Chief Operating Officer Doni Oskaria said the merger of PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) and PT PP (Persero) Tbk (PTPP), along with the merger of PT Nindya Karya with PT Brantas Abipraya (Persero), is expected to be completed by the end of November at the latest. After the mergers, the government will evaluate the companies' assets and divest non-core assets to reduce debt, while remaining debt will be restructured based on each company's repayment capacity, with additional capital an option if needed. The consolidation also aims to improve the business fundamentals and governance of the construction state-owned enterprises, including shifting financing to a project-based model rather than corporate financing. Meanwhile, PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA) and Waskita remain in restructuring due to more complex financial problems, as the government seeks a thorough resolution rather than merely extending debt tenors.

items.title: Haji Isam Acquires 10.084 Billion PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) Shares for Rp 26.10 Trillion via SPV Financing Structure
items.body: Entrepreneur Andi Syamsudduddin Arsyad, known as Haji Isam, acquired 10,084 billion shares of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) on 7 October 2026, equal to a 30.25 percent stake, at Rp 2,588 per share for a total of Rp 26.10 trillion (about USD 1.65 billion), reflecting 6.2x P/E and 1.9x P/BV. The acquisition was funded through two special purpose vehicles: an Acquisition SPV purchased the BYAN shares, while a Financing SPV obtained a financing facility from PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI). Collateral comprised 92.38 percent of shares in PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk (PGUN), valued at Rp 51.70 trillion, and 86.64 percent of shares in PT Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR), valued at Rp 28.63 trillion, pledged on 30 September 2026. Total collateral reached Rp 80.33 trillion (about USD 5.08 billion), or 3.08 times the acquisition value, with funds channeled to the Acquisition SPV via an intercompany loan.

items.title: IDX and KSEI Announce 99.95% of PT Bank of India Indonesia Tbk (BSWD) Shares Held by a Small Group of Investors
items.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI) placed PT Bank of India Indonesia Tbk (BSWD) on the High Shareholding Concentration (HSC) list, as certain shareholders collectively hold 99.95% of the company's shares as of 2 October 2026, leaving only about 0.05% spread among other holders. Both exchanges stated the announcement does not indicate any violation of capital market regulations. BSWD had already been suspended from trading in the Regular and Cash Markets since the pre-opening session on Monday, 5 October 2026, due to a significant cumulative price increase, with the suspension not yet lifted. Before the suspension, the stock traded at Rp3,600 per share, having risen 25% in a week, 140% in a month, and 165% in three months, and it was placed on the Unusual Market Activity (UMA) list on 1 October 2026.

items.title: Danantara Says Four BUMN Karya Mergers to Complete by November 2026, With Waskita and WIKA Excluded
items.body: BPI Danantara Chief Operating Officer Dony Oskaria said the mergers of four BUMN Karya companies will be completed by the end of November 2026, pairing PT Nindya Karya (Persero) with PT Brantas Abipraya (Persero), and listed companies PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) with PT PP (Persero) Tbk (PTPP). PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk (WSKT) and PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA) are excluded from the mergers because both require lengthy restructuring due to unhealthy finances. WIKA carries debt of about Rp 34 trillion, including obligations from the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed rail project, while Waskita holds toll road assets under review for potential divestment. After consolidation, Danantara plans to diversify non-core assets and use divestment proceeds to reduce debt, restructuring remaining obligations according to each company's repayment capacity.

items.title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas Raises PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) Target Price to Rp3,300 on Higher Coking Coal Assumptions
items.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas (BRIDS) raised its target price for PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) to Rp3,300 while maintaining a buy recommendation, driven by higher coking coal price assumptions of US$230 per ton for 2026, US$220 per ton for 2027, and US$200 per ton for 2028, up from US$170 per ton previously. The revision lifted BRIDS' earnings estimates for ADRO by 4.3% for 2026, 2.6% for 2027, and 2.9% for 2028, supported by strengthening Australian premium hard coking coal prices in the first nine months of 2026 due to supply disruptions from China and Mongolia. Its subsidiary PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR) faces logistics challenges on the Barito River, with third-quarter 2026 sales estimated at 500,000–700,000 tons, though BRIDS kept its full-year 2026 sales projection at 6 million tons, below management's initial 6.3 million ton target, and expects deliveries to catch up in the fourth quarter of 2026. ADRO currently trades at an estimated 6.4 times 2027 price-to-earnings ratio, about 13% below peers, with key risks being stricter implementation of Kepmen 365/2026 and potential coking coal price weakness.

items.title: Analysts Set New PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) Price Target of Rp68, Implying 137% Upside After Floor Price Removal
items.body: Analyst consensus compiled by Bloomberg sets a new average price target of Rp68 per share for PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO), implying a potential 137% point-to-point return over the next 12 months from the latest price of Rp29 per share. Of 29 analysts, 79.3% recommend buy, 17.2% hold, and 3.4% sell. Citi targets Rp80 per share, Mandiri Sekuritas Rp65, UOB Kay Hian Rp60, and Macquarie Rp48 with an outperform rating. Citi views the recent price decline after the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) removed the minimum trading price floor to Rp1 per share as largely technical price discovery rather than a fundamental change, and notes the unrealized Rp3.5 trillion buyback program as a supporting factor.

items.title: OJK Says Indonesia's Capital Market Reform 90% Complete, MSCI Concerns Addressed
items.body: OJK Deputy Commissioner Eddy Manindo said Indonesia's capital market reform is around 90% complete, with the main concerns of global index providers such as MSCI and FTSE addressed as of April-May 2026. Remaining work includes capital market democratization, whose legal basis was established through POJK Number 13 of 2026 on Stock Exchange Shareholders, effective September 15, 2026, as preparation for the demutualization of the Indonesia Stock Exchange. OJK has launched eight reform action plans across four clusters: liquidity improvement, transparency, governance and law enforcement, and inter-agency synergy. Implemented measures include raising the minimum free float from 7.5% to 15% gradually, monthly publication of shareholders holding above 1%, expanded investor classification from 9 to 39 categories, removal of the Rp50 minimum stock price, measured reintroduction of short selling, and strengthened investment manager governance through Bursa Regulation 1-A. OJK is also intensifying communication with global index providers and investors to ensure accurate information on reform progress.

items.title: Controlling Shareholder and Director of PT Mitra Pedagang Indonesia Tbk (MPIX) Sell Shares Worth Rp3.5 Billion
items.body: PT Mitra Pedagang Indonesia Tbk (MPIX) announced that its controlling shareholder and a board director sold shares on Monday, October 5, 2026. Controlling shareholder Madura Prima Investama sold 27,500,000 shares at Rp75 per share for Rp2 billion in a direct divestation, reducing its stake from 937.5 million shares (59.99%) to 910 million shares (58.23%). MPIX director Rio Adetya Rizky also divested 20,000,000 shares at Rp75 per share, raising Rp1.5 billion, cutting his direct ownership from 25,000,000 shares (1.59% of voting rights) to 5,000,000 shares (0.32%).

items.title: BRI Danareksa Raises Coking Coal Price Assumptions, Maintains Buy on PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR) with Rp 3,300 Target
items.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas raised its coking coal price assumptions for 2026, 2027, and 2028 to 230, 220, and 200 US dollars per ton respectively, up from 170 US dollars per ton, citing supply disruptions in China and Mongolia, and maintained a buy recommendation on PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR) with a raised target price of Rp 3,300. The broker kept its 2026 sales estimate for ADMR at 6 million tons, below management's initial target of 6.3 million tons, with third-quarter 2026 sales expected at only 500,000-700,000 tons due to Barito River conditions, with most sales drawn from stockpiles and the Indonesia Bulk Terminal (IBT) facility. Sales catch-up is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026 as ADMR's coal volumes are already contracted. ADMR's subsidiary PT Saptaindra Sejati (SIS) is forecast to record 204 million bank cubic meters of overburden removal and 68 million tons of coal production in 2026, with first-half 2026 realization of 87.7 million bcm and 32.3 million tons, or 43-47 percent of the broker's full-year estimates.

items.title: PGAS's Solid Cash Performance Seen Containing Gunvor Dispute Risk; Analysts Maintain Buy Ratings
items.body: Analysts at Sucor Sekuritas and Bahana Sekuritas view the LNG sales contract dispute with Gunvor Singapore as a temporary, non-structural risk for PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS), citing the company's strong operations and cash position. PGAS is projected to hold a net cash position of about US$0.9 billion with annual operating cash flow of US$0.7 billion, while distribution volume is forecast to reach 878 BBTUD in fiscal 2026, up 5% annually. Gunvor's arbitration claim is estimated at US$130.4 million; PGAS has provisioned about US$72 million for 2022-2024, and Bahana estimates a possible additional provision of US$58.4 million, which in a worst-case scenario could cut 2026 core profit by 19.3% to US$244.6 million and lower the 2026 dividend yield estimate from 11.9% to 9.5%. Sucor rates PGAS a Buy with a target price of Rp 2,020, while Bahana rates it a Buy with a target price of Rp 1,900.

items.title: Indonesian Government Issues Presidential Regulation No. 27 of 2026 Governing Ojol Tariffs for Package and Food Delivery
items.body: The Indonesian government issued Presidential Regulation (Perpres) Number 27 of 2026, extending legal protection to the digital platform-based transportation ecosystem, including ride-hailing drivers (ojol), goods delivery, and food orders. Deputy Speaker of the DPR RI Sufmi Dasco Ahmad led the announcement alongside ministers from the Red and White Cabinet at the Parliament Complex on Thursday (8/10). Minister of SMEs Maman Abdurrahman said the regulation will cover partnership agreements between platform operators and driver partners as well as culinary merchants and SME partners on online platforms, while Minister of Transportation Dudy Purwagandhi confirmed a maximum platform fee cut of 8%, also incorporated into a Transportation Ministry decree. Deputy Minister of Communication and Digital Nezar Patria stated that, under Article 11 Paragraph 4, his ministry has the authority to set logistics tariffs for goods and food delivery and will require platforms to ensure transparency in price formation for courier income adequacy. All implementing regulations from the ministries must be completed before December 31, 2026.

items.title: Bayan Resources' Low Tuck Kwong Divests 33.3 Million Shares Worth Rp 367.5 Billion
items.body: Low Tuck Kwong, Director of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN), reported selling 33,333,335 shares at Rp 11,025 per share on October 6, 2026, for a total of Rp 367.5 billion, reducing his stake from 40.25% to 40.15%. The transaction was facilitated on the Indonesia Stock Exchange negotiation market by Maybank Sekuritas on the buy side and UBS Sekuritas on the sell side, with the buyer not disclosed. Separately, a jumbo negotiation-market trade of 10.08 billion BYAN shares at Rp 2,588, worth Rp 26.1 trillion, occurred on October 7, 2026, matching the enlarged purchase portion of 10,084,088,370 shares under the amended conditional share purchase agreement signed October 1, 2026 by Low Tuck Kwong, Elaine Low, and PT Jhonlin Baratama, the company of Haji Isam, which would indirectly give Haji Isam a 30.25% stake in Bayan. BYAN shares weakened 1.99% to Rp 12,300 in regular trading on October 8, 2026, and Bayan's directors stated the events have no material negative impact on operations, legal aspects, financial condition, or business continuity.

items.title: PT Plaza Indonesia Realty Tbk (PLIN) to Distribute Rp 268 Billion Interim Dividend
items.body: PT Plaza Indonesia Realty Tbk (PLIN) plans to distribute an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 totaling Rp 268 billion, or Rp 76 per share, approved by the Board of Directors and ratified by the Board of Commissioners on 5 October 2026. As of 30 June 2026, the company reported net profit attributable to the parent entity of Rp 266.8 billion, unrestricted retained earnings of Rp 10.2 trillion, and total equity of Rp 11.3 trillion. The ex-dividend date is 16 October 2026 for the regular and negotiated markets and 20 October 2026 for the cash market, with cum-dividend dates on 15 and 19 October 2026 respectively. Shareholders recorded as of 19 October 2026 at 16:00 will be entitled to the cash dividend.

items.title: Indonesia Stock Exchange Suspends Trading of Four State-Owned Construction Stocks
items.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) has suspended trading of four state-owned construction companies (BUMN Karya): PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI), PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA), PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk (WSKT), and PT PP (Persero) Tbk (PTPP), with the suspension remaining in effect through trading on Thursday, October 8, 2026. Last prices before suspension stood at Rp 133 for ADHI, Rp 204 for WIKA, Rp 202 for WSKT, and Rp 161 for PTPP. PTPP was the latest suspended, halted from the pre-opening session on Monday, October 5, 2026, after it deferred interest payments on its Bonds Continuing III Phase I Year 2021 Series B and Sukuk Mudharabah Continuing I Phase I Year 2021 Series B due October 2, 2026, which the IDX said indicated going-concern problems. ADHI was suspended from August 24, 2026 after deferring the 17th interest payment on its bonds worth Rp 60.8 billion, while WIKA has been suspended since February 18, 2025 following deferred profit-sharing payments on two mudharabah sukuk. WSKT has been under IDX suspension the longest among the four.

items.title: Ahead of BYAN acquisition, Haji Isam-affiliated companies pledge PGUN shares
items.body: Three companies affiliated with Andi Syamsudin Arsyad (Haji Isam) signed share pledge agreements over PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk (PGUN) shares with PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) on 30 September 2026, as collateral for credit facilities obtained by the company's affiliates. PT Araya Agro Lestari pledged 2.2 billion PGUN shares (38.44%), PT Citra Agro Raya pledged 2.19 billion shares (38.25%), and PT Baramega Citra Mulia Persada pledged 900 million shares (15.69%), totaling 5.29 billion shares or 92.38% of PGUN. Based on PGUN's September 2026 closing price of Rp9,750 per share and an assumed 50% haircut, the three entities could raise around Rp25.7 trillion. The pledge comes amid Haji Isam's planned acquisition of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) shares from Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low, with the agreed portion raised to 30.25%, while another Haji Isam issuer, PT Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR), also signed a share pledge agreement to obtain fresh funds from a bank.

items.title: Booming Data Center Demand Draws Attention to PT Puradelta Lestari Tbk (DMAS) as Deltamas Land Prices Nearly Double
items.body: Mirae Asset Sekuritas highlights PT Puradelta Lestari Tbk (DMAS), the developer of the Deltamas industrial area in Cikarang, West Java, as a beneficiary of Indonesia's fastest-growing data center cluster. Around 350 hectares of land have been sold to about 20 data center operators, with land prices nearly doubling since December 2025 to about Rp 9.5 million per square meter. Demand has shifted to Deltamas partly due to stricter data center approval processes in Johor, Malaysia, with buyers securing land early and rarely negotiating prices. The Greenland International Industrial Center (GIIC) offers around 2,500 MVA of electricity capacity from two grids, direct supply from PT PLN (Persero) at about Rp 1,300 per kWh versus about Rp 2,500 per kWh in other Cikarang areas, three fiber points of interest, and licensed water capacity expanded to 220,000 cubic meters per day. With industrial land effectively sold out, DMAS has begun converting commercial land to meet data center demand.

items.title: PT Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati Tbk (MBSS) Denies Corporate Action Plans After 54.64% Share Price Surge
items.body: PT Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati Tbk (MBSS) stated in a disclosure to the Indonesia Stock Exchange that it has no corporate action plans within the next three months that would affect its stock listing, and no known material information behind the recent share price rally. MBSS shares rose 54.64% to Rp4,500 per share over the past week, following the control transfer to conglomerate Andy Wibowo, known as Haji Andy, via his investment vehicle PT Wibowo Group Capital, which acquired around 1.44 billion shares from previous controller PT Galley Adhika Arnawama for about Rp4.2 trillion in early August 2026. Market rumors of a plan to consolidate around 180 ships from Gandasari Group into MBSS drove the rally, though the company denied knowledge of material facts. Active buyers included Ciptadana Sekuritas Asia (33.2 thousand lots, Rp13.6 billion), BNI Sekuritas (28.7 thousand lots), Lotus Andalan Sekuritas (22.3 thousand lots), and CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia (22.6 thousand lots, Rp9.7 billion), while sellers included Elit Sukses Sekuritas (50.8 thousand lots, Rp15.9 billion), Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia (32.5 thousand lots), Panin Sekuritas (20.6 thousand lots), and UBS Sekuritas Indonesia (21.6 thousand lots, Rp9.6 billion).

items.title: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) to divest entire stake in PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo for Rp1.77 trillion
items.body: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) plans to sell its entire 47.18% stake, or 1,714,808 shares, in PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo (JMJ) to PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur (Persero) (SMI) for Rp1,7658 trillion under a conditional sale agreement signed on 30 September 2026, with completion targeted by 30 November 2026. After the transaction, ADHI will no longer hold JMJ shares, while SMI will become a JMJ shareholder alongside PT Jasa Marga (Persero) Tbk. The divestment is part of ADHI's asset recycling strategy to strengthen its financial condition and refocus on its core construction business, with proceeds earmarked for interest-bearing debt repayment, working capital, and other priority needs. The sale price is 1.75% above the independent appraiser's market valuation of Rp1,7355 trillion as of 30 June 2026, and the transaction, pending BPJT notification, technical approvals, and an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders on 13 November 2026, will also end ADHI's exposure to JMJ's expected early-stage losses from the Solo-Yogyakarta-NYIA Kulon Progo toll road concession.

items.title: R Hesthi Sambodo Buy Shares of Transkon Jaya
items.body: On Oct 8, 2026, insider R Hesthi Sambodo purchased 18,100 Transkon Jaya (TRJA.JK) shares at IDR 117 per share, costing IDR 2,117,700 and raising his stake to 471,900 shares, or roughly 0.03% of the company. The purchase follows two earlier acquisitions in August—950,100 shares at IDR 108.95 and 48,200 shares at IDR 109—indicating a continued, albeit modest, accumulation by the insider over the past six months.

items.title: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) Shares Fall 5% a Day After Announcing US$200 Million Deal with US Oil and Gas Company HighPeak Energy
items.body: Shares of Bakrie-affiliated oil and gas issuer PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) fell 5% to Rp1,005 per share in morning trading on Thursday (8/10/2026), with transaction volume of 46.94 million shares across 6,330 trades worth Rp48.28 billion. The decline came a day after the company announced a business cooperation with Danantara, signing an agreement worth US$200 million (around Rp3.6 trillion) with HighPeak Energy, Inc., a US oil and gas company, through the purchase of newly issued convertible preferred shares that can be converted into HighPeak common shares. HighPeak, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, focuses on hydrocarbon development and exploration in the Midland Basin, West Texas, and recorded average daily sales volume of about 45,456 barrels of oil equivalent per day (BOEPD) for the six months ended June 30, 2026. ENRG management said growth will remain focused on a combination of organic and inorganic expansion, including disciplined pursuit of acquisitions and investments in Indonesia and international markets.

items.title: Analysts See PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) Valuation Far Above Current Market Perception
items.body: Analysts at Bloomberg Intelligence estimate the equity value of PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) could be 67%-128% higher than its current market capitalization, including a fintech business valuation of US$1.9 billion-US$2.8 billion. GoPay posted gross transaction value of Rp288 trillion in January-June 2026, up 82% year-on-year, with net revenue of about Rp4 trillion and adjusted EBITDA up 526% annually to Rp845 billion, while GOTO recorded a net profit of Rp607 billion and net revenue of Rp10.99 trillion in H1-2026, led by delivery services revenue of Rp3.2 trillion (+16.5%), service fees of Rp3.15 trillion (+14.9%), and loan revenue of Rp2.71 trillion (+65%). Analyst consensus as of October 7, 2026 comprises 22 buy, 6 hold, and 1 sell ratings, with a 12-month target price of Rp70.5 per share implying 127.4% upside from the prior close of about Rp31; Deutsche Bank maintained a DCF valuation of Rp85 per share and JP Morgan an overweight rating with a Rp68 target, viewing a downside floor of Rp25-Rp30 per share based on a sum-of-the-parts valuation of Rp26 per share. Uber's US$14.8 billion acquisition of Delivery Hero has renewed interest in GOTO as a potential candidate in the ASEAN market, and analysts suggested a potential spin-off and listing of the GoPay fintech unit on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX), though management has not signaled such a plan.

items.title: Haji Isam's PT Jhonlin Baratama Increases Stake Purchase in PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) as IDX Reviews the Deal
items.body: Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) is reviewing the conditional share purchase agreement (PJBS) between PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN), the mining issuer owned by conglomerate Low Tuck Kwong, and buyer PT Jhonlin Baratama, owned by Haji Isam. The revised agreement, signed on 1 October 2026, increased the shares to be transferred from 10,000,000,500 to 10,084,088,370 common shares, raising PT Jhonlin Baratama's stake from 30% to about 30.252% of the company. IDX disclosure director Saidu Solihin said the exchange had requested and received clarification on the number of shares, transaction pricing basis, and control status, and does not regulate pricing in share transfers as it is an agreement between the parties. Management stated the transaction will not have a material negative impact on BYAN's operations, legal aspects, financial condition, or business continuity.

items.title: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) to Sell Entire Stake in PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo for Rp1.77 Trillion and Redirect Rp378.69 Billion of Rights Issue Funds to Working Capital
items.body: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) plans to sell its entire 47.18% stake, or 1,714,808 shares, in PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo (JMJ), the concession holder of the Solo-Yogyakarta-NYIA Kulon Progo toll road, to PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur (Persero) for Rp1,765,816,000,000, a price 1.75% above the appraised market value of Rp1.74 trillion as of June 30, 2026. After the transaction, ADHI will hold no JMJ shares, leaving PT Jasa Marga (Persero) Tbk (JSMR) as the remaining shareholder with 52.82%. ADHI also proposes reallocating the remaining Rp378.69 billion of net proceeds from its October 2022 PMHMETD II rights issue, which raised Rp2.65 trillion, from capital injections into subsidiaries to working capital, cutting the JMJ allocation to Rp1.68 trillion from Rp2 trillion, PT Jasamarga Jogja Bawen to Rp532.19 billion from Rp535 billion, PT Jalintim Adhi Abipraya to Rp54.32 billion from Rp70 billion, and waste management and toll road investment to Rp2.69 billion from Rp41.5 billion. Both plans, aligned with Presidential Instruction Number 7 of 2025 on SOE restructuring, require shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on Friday, November 13, 2026, with the JMJ sale targeted for completion by November 30, 2026 pending BPJT confirmation.

items.title: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) to Repurpose Rp378.69 Billion of 2022 Rights Issue Proceeds as Working Capital, Calls Extraordinary General Meeting
items.body: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) plans to change the allocation of remaining proceeds from its 2022 rights issue (PMHMETD II), proposing to redirect Rp378.69 billion of the Rp2.65 trillion raised to the company's working capital. The funds will support completion of carry-over projects, including construction materials, labor and subcontractor payments, and equipment mobilization. The reallocation follows Presidential Instruction Number 7 of 2025 on BUMN streamlining, cutting planned capital injections into subsidiaries including PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo (from Rp2.00 trillion to Rp1.68 trillion), PT Jasamarga Jogja Bawen (to Rp532.18 billion from Rp535.00 billion), and PT Jalintim Adhi Abipraya (to Rp54.31 billion from Rp70.00 billion), while waste treatment and toll road investment allocations fall from Rp41.49 billion to Rp2.69 billion. An Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders will be held on Friday, 13 November 2026, at ADHI Tower in East Jakarta, also covering approval of a material transaction on the planned divestment of ADHI's shareholding in PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo.

items.title: PT Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR) Shares Plunge Over 11% After Haji Isam Pledges Controlling Stake to Bank Mandiri
items.body: Shares of PT Jhonlin Agro Raya Tbk (JARR) fell 11.37% to Rp3,040 on Thursday (October 8, 2026), a day after Haji Isam announced the pledging of the company's controlling shares to PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI). Haji Isam pledged all shares held by PT Eshan Agro Sentosa, JARR's controlling shareholder, totaling about 7.99 billion shares or 86.64% of the company, on September 30, 2026. JARR President Director Indra Irawan stressed the pledge does not change control of the company. Haji Isam also pledged shares of PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk (PGUN) to Bank Mandiri, and PGUN shares fell 1.91% to Rp9,000; the pledges come amid Haji Isam's move, via PT Jhonlin Baratama, to increase its planned acquisition of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) shares to about 30.25%, though JARR stated it is not involved in or financing that acquisition.

items.title: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara (MKNT) Completes Rp1.02 Trillion Private Placement and Renames to Remitra Global International
items.body: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara (MKNT) completed a private placement of up to Rp1.02 trillion by issuing 1.02 trillion shares at an exercise price of Rp1 per share, and shareholders approved renaming the company to Remitra Global International at an extraordinary general meeting on 14 September 2026. The placement comprised debt conversion to Headwell Bintang Energi Hijau (HBEH) of Rp668 billion and Mantra Capital Persada (MCP) of Rp154.92 billion, a Rp1.56 billion cash injection from MCP, and Rp200 billion from five independent investors: Suripto, John Veter Firdaus, and Antony Lesmana at Rp50 billion each, and Daniel Tejakusuma and Rossa Linna at Rp25 billion each. The Rp1.56 billion MCP cash injection will settle the remaining purchase price for Raja Udang Malingping (RUM) shares from Mazon Bumi Mining, while independent investor funds will be allocated Rp160 billion to Citra Baru Steel (CBS) and Rp30 billion to RUM for working capital and investment plans, with Rp9.99 billion for operational working capital. Following completion, the company's issued and paid-up shares increased to 1.03 trillion shares from 5.5 billion shares, and paid-up capital rose to Rp1.13 trillion from Rp110 billion.
